name: Noel Valmore
original_name: ノエル ヴァルモール
source: A seemingly pretentious magician who considers Julius to be a rival. He's actually a kind-hearted boy who wishes to use his magic to help people and to become a great magician.
translation: A seemingly pretentious magician who considers Julius to be a rival. He's actually a kind-hearted boy who wishes to use his magic to help people and to become a great magician.
